title: Top 7 AI Email Marketing Tools for Marketers

facts.fact: The page is titled 'Top 7 AI Email Marketing Tools for Marketers in 2026' and states it was published on March 6, 2025.
Optimove's pricing is listed as Customized, and the page says it offers customized quotes depending on business size and stage.
facts.quote: Optimove offers customized quotes depending on the size and stage of your business

facts.fact: The page's comparison table lists Kit (formerly ConvertKit) with a starting price of $25 onwards.
The page's comparison table lists Rasa with a starting price of $190 onwards.
The page's comparison table lists GetResponse with a starting price of $15 onwards.
facts.quote: For AI-powered email and campaign generation | $15 onwards

facts.fact: The page's comparison table lists Mailmodo with a starting price of $49 onwards.
The page's comparison table lists Jasper with a starting price of $39 onwards.
The page's comparison table lists Active Campaign with a starting price of $15 onwards.
facts.quote: Drag and drop email builder | $15 onwards

facts.fact: The page's comparison table lists Zeta with Custom pricing.
The page reports Optimove's rating as 4.3 on Capterra, a third-party review site, not the vendor's own figure.
The page reports Optimove's rating as 4.6 on G2, a third-party review site.
The authors say they evaluated tools by analyzing customer reviews on Capterra, G2, and TrustPilot.
facts.quote: we carefully analyzed customer reviews on Capterra, G2, and TrustPilot

facts.fact: The page's comparison table lists Optimove's best use as large businesses.
facts.quote: Multi-channel marketing campaign | Customized | Large businesses
